serverInfo.name: familyplate
serverInfo.title: FamilyPlate
serverInfo.description: Smart family dinner planning & pantry management. Expose pantry items, meal plans, saved recipes, and grocery list actions to agents.

transport.description: FamilyPlate exposes tools via WebMCP in-browser and via the FamilyPlate CLI for trusted terminal agents. Create an agent connection from Settings, then run the generated familyplate connect command.

authentication.description: Agent tokens are created and revoked from FamilyPlate Settings. Tokens are shown once and are sent as Bearer tokens to the Convex agent API.
